title: Introductory Statistics
description: An introduction to descriptive and basic inferential statistics. Quantitative statistical techniques used in health research are discussed and applied using MS Excel software. Applied methods and strategies commonly used in quantitative analysis will be explored and a range of descriptive and inferential statistical approaches examined.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HLTH 425, NURS 425.
Students must have access to a PC Windows platform for this course.
